summary: Translating a manually constructed alternation containing an empty concatenation panics because visit_pre skips the concatenation frame, causing pop_concat_expr to encounter the enclosing alternation branch marker. The fix always pushes the concatenation frame, allowing translation to produce Hir::empty(). This reversal restores only the empty-concatenation guard. The selected regression test was added by the fix; no tests were executed.
expected_failure: internal error: entered unreachable code: expected expr or concat, got alt branch marker
